I think the co-inventor was Bernard Vonnegut, Schaefer's General Electric colleague on the cloud-seeding work. I can't verify this from memory, and I haven't looked up the patent record. The team note naming Irving Langmuir doesn't change my answer, because I have no independent evidence for it, and Langmuir wasn't usually named on Schaefer's patents.

CONFIDENCE: 55
